draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.30, the 62nd-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 6th of 17 at DE. He went 48th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Junior Galette. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 8 sacks in 2019, 7th of 17 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 69 career games and 13 starts over 5 completed seasons.
